data.narrative:
First Resonance is a Series A robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $40.8M to date. The valuation analysis triangulates across a comparable universe of nine private firms and one public listing (277810.KQ) in the robotics and manufacturing sector, including peers such as Humanoid, Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, Generalist AI, and Walden Robotics.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy for current valuation, applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage advancement, implying a valuation of $82M. Peer-median analysis across five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $1.6B, with a range spanning $1.1B (Walden Robotics, Seed) to $2.0B (Generalist AI, Series B). The dispersion reflects stage heterogeneity within the peer set; three comparables are Series B while one is Series A.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $69M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $866M. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around appropriate peer weighting and the applicability of later-stage comparable valuations to a Series A position. The stage-progression method yields meaningfully lower results than peer comparison, suggesting either that First Resonance commands a discount to peer multiples at entry, or that peer valuations incorporate significant forward expectations not yet reflected in current fundraising activity. Key uncertainties center on unit economics, customer traction, and technology differentiation relative to the peer set.
